title: fix: stop sending the literal string "undefined" as client_id
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Found in the first real `page_viewed` rows after #15155 deployed: every browser view without an app key wrote `client_id = "undefined"`.

`client_id: (params.get("client_id") ?? params.get("app_key") ?? undefined)?.slice(0, 100)` sets the key explicitly. Zod's `.optional()` keeps a present-but-undefined key, and `new URLSearchParams({client_id: undefined})` serializes it as the string `"undefined"`.

Fix: spread the key in only when there is a value. Adds a regression assertion that a parsed view with no optionals serializes to exactly `page=%2Ftop-up`.

`referrer_host` and the `utm_*` fields were never affected — `sourceAttribution()` omits missing keys rather than setting them undefined.

Existing bad rows are limited to the ~1 hour since the beacon started working and can be excluded with `client_id != 'undefined'`.

gist.headline: Undefined leaves the garden
gist.blurb: The page-view beacon has stopped planting the literal word "undefined" where an app client ID should be. Analytics rows without an app key are clean again, as nature intended.
gist.summary: Fixed enter.pollinations.ai page-view serialization so missing client_id/app_key values are omitted from URLSearchParams instead of being recorded as the literal string "undefined", with a regression test confirming an optional-free view serializes as page=%2Ftop-up.
gist.impact: Analytics for browser views without an app key now retains an absent client_id rather than a misleading "undefined" value, while referrer_host and UTM attribution continue to be preserved normally.

Small code-plants and attribution flowers represent correctly omitted optional fields and clean event data.
